719:t_013:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Why the hell would I tell you?!」

719:t_013:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「...I meant to take your $$スフィア$$s later, but if you're going to get in my way, it can't be helped...」

719:t_014:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「The me of now can do things like this, too.」

719:t_015:0.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「That bastard! He's taken the $$アンチスパイラル$$'s forces under his control!」

719:t_015:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「So when he said he got stronger, it wasn't just talk!」

719:t_016:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You need to feel in your own skin what this $$シュロウガ$$'s existence means, too.」

719:t_016:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「So fighting the $$御使い$$s together with us isn't an option for you.」

719:t_016:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「We won't know until we try, will we!」

719:t_016:5.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「We won't know until we try, will we!」

719:t_016:6.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「We won't know until we try, will we!」

719:t_016:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「Are you looking down on us, $$アサキム$$?」

719:t_016:9.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Very well! I'll teach you the fact that you can never defeat them!」

719:t_017:0.en:
$$シン$$
「How do you like that, $$アサキム$$! We win!」

719:t_017:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「For all your big talk, that's all you've got!」

719:t_019:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「As you can see. As my power rises, the curse carved into them has grown stronger as well.」

719:t_019:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「And they have made this curse their own power.」

719:t_019:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「While I'm at it, you should learn more about them.」

719:t_019:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I'll allow you to meet that $$哀しみのサクリファイ$$.」

719:t_020:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「In a sense, it's a complete defeat...」

719:t_020:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Yeah... Even if we defeat him, it wouldn't count as a victory...」

719:t_020:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「On top of that, he wasn't even attacking seriously, just to show us that...」

719:t_020:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「An opponent we can't defeat even by shooting him down... And on top of that, we can't see the limit of his power...」

719:t_020:6.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If the $$御使い$$s have more power than him...」

719:t_020:7.en:
$$カツ$$
「There's no way we can win against that...」

719:t_020:8.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「If they were just strong, we could work out how to fight them, but if the opponent is immortal...」

719:t_020:13.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Do you even get it?! Our opponent is immortal!」

719:t_020:14.en:
$$ランド$$
「If we can't beat him, there are ways like sealing him away in $$ＺＯＮＥ$$.」

719:t_020:15.en:
$$セツコ$$
「That's why we mustn't lose hope.」

719:t_020:16.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's right, Chief, AG. We'll be the ones to stop $$アサキム$$ and the $$御使い$$s, but I'm counting on you two to handle what comes after.」

719:t_020:18.en:
$$トライア$$
「First, let's think about how to make the most of the chance $$アサキム$$ gave us.」

719:t_020:19.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$哀しみのサクリファイ$$... So that's her name...」

719:t_020:20.en:
$$レド$$
「But what do we do? That crystal asteroid doesn't seem like it can be damaged by attacks.」

719:t_020:21.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So it's the same kind of thing as the $$スヴェル$$.」

719:t_021:1.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Is the $$悲しみの乙女$$'s $$スフィア$$ reacting...!」

719:t_021:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...Even if we can't destroy it, if we synchronize our consciousness, we might be able to get past that wall.」

719:t_022:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「So that's... $$哀しみのサクリファイ$$...」

719:t_023:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「What the $$アンチスパイラル$$ left behind isn't forces for the $$御使い$$s to use! It's the wish that we protect this universe!」

719:t_023:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let's go! For that, too, we'll smash all of that guy's forces here!」

719:t_024:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「Confirmed, $$エル・ミレニウム$$ is down!」

719:t_024:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「We're doing better than I expected, aren't we!」

719:t_024:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Naturally. To my eyes, that one's $$真化融合$$ is nothing but a fake.」

719:t_024:3.en:
$$アル$$
「Sergeant, please explain your grounds for that.」

719:t_024:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's simple. That one only controls the machine; it is not one with the machine.」

719:t_024:5.en:
$$レド$$
「Right. It's the same as the difference between domination and coexistence.」

719:t_024:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Analysis indicates an overall improvement in capability, but it is judged not to match the enhancement of allied units during their $$真化融合$$.」

719:t_024:7.en:
$$レド$$
「There's no need to fear a counterfeit! Let's finish it off quickly!」

719:t_100:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「From the crystal monster, I can feel the will of that $$御使い$$ named $$テンプティ$$...!」

719:t_100:2.en:
$n
「That's exactly what makes $$テンプティ$$ terrifying...! As long as she's having fun, she won't hesitate for a moment to take someone's life!」

719:t_101:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Learn this: from here on, none of your common sense will work in these battles.」

719:t_101:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You'll be happier being hunted by me here!」

719:t_101:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I won't let anyone else decide my happiness! Least of all you!」

719:t_102:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Enough of looking down on us, $$アサキム$$!」

719:t_102:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That's not my intention. I'm grateful to you.」

719:t_102:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「For raising the $$スフィア$$s for me until today!」

719:t_102:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's exactly what I mean by looking down on us! I'll give you what's coming, $$アサキム$$!」

719:t_103:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Quit playing it up, $$アサキム$$. Hurry up and go all out.」

719:t_103:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You can't fool those eyes of yours, $$クロウ$$.」
